descriptions.w3d_d27k_transfer_reply_8025afc4: Handles a transfer reply for the asset found through 0x8025d588: mode 0 stores the mode and state 4; mode 1 fills packet 0x8041a9e8 (name, mode, +64, +44, next id), sends it and opens the reader at +76 on the request text, or finishes when flag 64 is clear; other modes check the checksum through 0x8021d5c4 and send the packet with 0 and a seek to the length, or with 1, then open the reader, store state 2 and the start time.
